title: Cook log stamp time
scenario: The cook says "I just wrapped it", leaves the review list up for two minutes, then taps Fill.
now: the stamp is logged at the moment of Fill, on the backend's clock. Never backdated.
wants: the entry stamped at the Ramble's time (AC 5, "at the time of the Ramble").
why: AC 5 and Spec #700's "backend untouched" cannot both hold; the cook sees a different time on the cook-log entry either way.

options.cost: Nothing. Seconds of drift in the normal flow.
This PR merges as is; a new Slice adds an optional time to `POST cook-events`.
Backend change inside a frontend Slice; verification re-runs.

title: Serve time or rest spoken with no Serve Plan card
scenario: The planner is off; the cook says "rest it 45 minutes".
now: goes to Notes; the shared rest duration is not written.
wants: written to the Serve Plan anyway (stories 40 and 43 say the Ramble sets serve time and rest).
why: Spec #700 says both "a Ramble fills only the screen it was spoken on" and stories 40/43; the cook sees either a filled rest or a Notes line.

options.text: Write the Serve Plan value even with the card hidden.
options.cost: Fix in this PR; verification re-runs.
